property_summary: For any successful payable fallback call that requires msg.value == 10 ether and passes the timestamp check, the reference contract always sets pastBlockTime strictly greater than the block.timestamp observed immediately before the call returns (it sets pastBlockTime = block.timestamp + 1), whereas the mutant that sets pastBlockTime = block.timestamp can make pastBlockTime equal to that timestamp for some inputs, violating the strict > relation.
change_summary: Set pastBlockTime to block.timestamp (not +1), changing resulting stored value after fallback returns.
